name: Everglades National Park
policyReason: Leashed pets are allowed in parking lots, campgrounds and along roads, not on trails.
summary: Leashed pets are allowed in parking lots, campgrounds and along roads, not on trails.

excerpts.quote: Pets are allowed (6-foot (2 m) leash) in parking lots and frontcountry campgrounds, but not on trails, in backcountry campsites, or in wilderness areas.

dogRules.text: Not on trails, backcountry campsites or wilderness.
Campgrounds, parking lots and roadsides only.
Keep pets well back from shorelines; alligators can attack.
